newsitem.title: USA: Sinclair Broadcast closes credit amendment.
newsitem.headline: Sinclair Broadcast closes credit amendment.

text.p: Sinclair Broadcast Group Inc said on Wednesday that it had closed on an amendment and restatement of its existing credit facility, providing about $7 million in annual savings.

The amendment allows for reductions in the rate of interest of up to 1 percent per annum, an increase in the facility size to $1 billion, reductions in the amount of principal must be repaid each year and a relaxation of the financial covenants, Sinclair said in a statement.
Proceeds of the amended credit facility will be used to refinance existing bank debt, to provide funding for future acquisitions and to provide funds for general corporate purposes, the company said.
In addition, "the reduction in the interest spread charged by the bank group will provide approximately $7 million in savings annually," said Sinclair chief financial officer David Amy.
Sinclair Broadcast Group Inc is a broadcast groups that owns or provides programming services to 28 television stations in 20 separate markets.
